const bin = $input.first().binary && $input.first().binary.image
if (!bin) return [{ json: { error: 'Walang larawan. Ipadala ang file sa field na "image".' } }]
const ok = ['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/gif']
const mediaType = bin.mimeType === 'image/jpg' ? 'image/jpeg' : bin.mimeType
if (!ok.includes(mediaType)) return [{ json: { error: 'Ang larawan ay dapat PNG, JPG, WEBP o GIF (nakuha: ' + bin.mimeType + ').' } }]
const buf = await this.helpers.getBinaryDataBuffer(0, 'image')
if (buf.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return [{ json: { error: 'Masyadong malaki ang larawan (higit 5 MB). Paliitin o i-crop ito.' } }]
const body = {
  model: 'claude-opus-5-5',
  max_tokens: 16000,
  thinking: { type: 'adaptive' },
  output_config: { effort: 'high', format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"rows":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"label":{"type":"string"},"month":{"type":"integer"},"day":{"type":"integer"},"time":{"type":"string"},"uncertain":{"type":"boolean"},"note":{"type":"string"}},"required":["title","label","month","day","time","uncertain","note"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["rows"],"additionalProperties":false} } },
  system: 'You are a precise transcription tool. You copy what is visible and never guess.',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [
    { type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: mediaType, data: buf.toString('base64') } },
    { type: 'text', text: "This image is a screenshot of a project-board subitem table. Transcribe EVERY row, top to bottom, exactly as it is shown.\n\nColumns to read: Subitem (the name), Label, Date (month and day only, no year), Time (12-hour with AM/PM).\n\nStrict rules:\n- Copy each Subitem name character for character. Keep codes such as BAY-1126CT, spacing, slashes and capitalisation exactly as shown. Never correct, shorten or reformat a name.\n- Label: copy the visible text. If the label is cut off with \"...\" in the image, return only the visible text without the ellipsis, set uncertain to true and explain in note.\n- Date: month as a number 1-12 and day as a number. Time: convert to 24-hour \"HH:MM\" (04:30 PM -> \"16:30\", 10:00 AM -> \"10:00\", 12:00 AM -> \"00:00\", 12:00 PM -> \"12:00\").\n- Include a row only if its Subitem, Date and Time are all readable. A row that is cut off at the edge of the image and not fully readable must be left out.\n- If any value is blurry, ambiguous or guessed, set uncertain to true and describe the doubt in note. Otherwise uncertain is false and note is an empty string.\n- Do not invent, merge, skip or reorder rows. Ignore checkboxes, owner avatars, chat icons and any other column." },
  ] }],
}
return [{ json: { body } }]
